# FFL Accelerator

FFL Accelerator is Coriolis’s plan for a gun store website. $569 a month. We build WooCommerce on your domain and run it with you. Betsy is on the shop. If you leave, the website goes with you.

Setup is $500 for a clean branded shop, or $2,500 for the full custom site and email. No year-long lock.

Publisher: Coriolis, LLC. Greenville, SC.

## What you get
A store on your name. FFL checkout. Distributor catalogs when you want them. The register you already run, connected if you want. Betsy on the shop so you see what they typed. Unlimited WP Engine hosting. 99.95% uptime commitment. Support Monday through Friday. Managed email: welcome, back in stock, abandoned cart, thank you.
